sehemu: Part III: The Prime Minister, the Cabinet and the Government
maudhui: (1) The tenure of office of a Minister or Deputy Minister shall commence on the date on which he is appointed to that office. (2) The office of a Minister or Deputy Minister shall become vacant upon the occurrence of any of the following events: (a) if the holder resigns or dies; (b) if the holder ceases to be a Member of Parliament for any reason other than the dissolution of Parliament; (c) if the President revokes the appointment and removes the holder from office; (d) if he is elected Speaker; (e) if the Prime Minister resigns or the office of Prime Minister becomes vacant; (f) when the President-elect assumes the office of President; or (g) if the Ethics Tribunal gives a decision confirming that he has contravened the law concerning the ethics of public leaders.
